name: Tm Docs Reader
pitch: The docs of your installed Tallmaker extensions, inside the app: an index, contents, pages and search. Free.
question: How do I use this Tallmaker extension, in the version we run?
questions: Which Tallmaker extensions are installed, and which docs version do they ship?
Where is the setting that changes this chart?
Can a demo app carry the help for its own extension?
useWhen: Help for installed Tallmaker extensions, inside Qlik.
audience: App authors and users of Tallmaker extensions who want help next to the sheet.
features: Lists installed Tallmaker products with docs
Docs always match the installed version
Contents, pages and search across products
Lock to one product for a help sheet

featureStrips.heading: Every installed product in one index
featureStrips.text: The reader finds the Tallmaker extensions installed on your tenant that ship docs, and lists each with its docs version.
featureStrips.alt: The installed products index with Tm Docs Reader and its docs version badge.

featureStrips.heading: Docs that match the installed version
featureStrips.text: Each extension ships its docs inside its own zip, so the reader always shows the docs of the version you run. No archive, no drift.
featureStrips.alt: A product's contents with the badge Docs for version 0.1.0.

featureStrips.heading: Readable pages
featureStrips.text: Headings, lists, code and links, drawn as plain text by the reader. Previous and Next walk the pages in order.
featureStrips.alt: A docs page with a code block and Previous and Next links.

featureStrips.heading: Search across products
featureStrips.text: Type a word to find the pages that hold it, in every installed product, or in the locked product only.
featureStrips.alt: Search results with two pages and their product name.

featureStrips.heading: A help sheet for one product
featureStrips.text: Lock the reader to one product and it skips the index and opens that product. Set a start page to open the right page first.
featureStrips.alt: A reader locked to Tm Docs Reader, open at its Settings page.

featureStrips.heading: Opens from an extension's Help
featureStrips.text: An extension's Help action can move to the reader's sheet and open the right page. Nothing is written to the app.
featureStrips.alt: The docs page that explains how an extension opens the reader at a page.
